data.name: Alveera
data.gender_notes: Alveera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle and soothing, just like a gentle breeze or a calm sea. The name Alveera carries the meaning “Gentle one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Alveera usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation.
data.etymology: Alveera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alveera total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Alveera
in_english.meaning: A beautiful and high moral girl
in_english.long_meaning: Alveera is an Arabic name that signifies a beautiful girl with high morals and good character. The name is derived from Arabic words that convey beauty, nobility, and kindness. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with feminine virtues and spiritual growth.

This name can be considered as an expression of the noble qualities cherished in the Muslim community, particularly in the context of respect and compassion towards others. In various cultural scenarios, names have considerable importance in defining a person's identity and character; Alveera, being a beautiful and evocative name, implies a gentle and nurturing personality.
data.spiritual_significance: Within the spiritual realm, the name Alveera holds a deep symbolic meaning for Muslims, as it reminds one of the soothing and gentle influence of Allah (God) in their lives. The name itself invokes images of calmness and serenity, which can be seen as a reflection of the peace and contentment that comes from a strong and unwavering connection to the Divine. The spiritual journey towards self-improvement and eternal bliss involves remaining steadfast even in the face of trials and tribulations. The gentle influence of the name Alveera can serve as a source of comfort and strength for those embarking on this spiritual quest, offering solace and guidance as they navigate through life's challenges and seek to draw closer to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Alveera signifies the one who is free from worldly attachments and solely devoted to the remembrance of Allah, moving forward on the path of righteousness with unwavering determination.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Masudi, Muruj Al-Dhahab wa Ma'adin Al-Jawhar, Vol. II, p. 118 The name Alveera carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Masudi mentions Alveera as a city in Yemen, which was famous for its gold mines and was under the control of the Himyarite Kingdom.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Idrisi, Nuzhat Al-Mushtaq fi Ikhtiraq Al-Afaq, Vol. II, p. 364 The name Alveera carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi mentions Alveera as a city in Yemen, which was an important commercial center and was renowned for its frankincense production.
